mismatches.disposition: Algorithm32 Paper has no ground-reflection contribution, while the matched libRadtran setup uses Lambertian grass spectral albedo. This remains an explicit scope limitation.

Algorithm32 Paper uses the production Default second-order incident-radiance approximation rather than libRadtran DISORT's fuller multiple-scattering solution. Aggregate-score proximity does not establish component, order-by-order, or pointwise equality.
Algorithm32 Paper uses the pinned 34-direction source-oriented equal-weight Fibonacci incoming quadrature; the retained libRadtran DISORT calculation uses 16 streams.

Algorithm32 Paper uses analytic exponential density profiles, 48 physical altitude nodes, 40 view-path intervals, and 20 source-transmittance intervals; libRadtran uses its retained layered atmosphere and solver controls.
